value.name: man brings apology croissants
value.description: A man arrives at eight with croissants, apparently as a wordless apology.
evidence: "He came at eight. He brought croissants."
"From the place on Twentieth. I think it's his way of apologizing without using words."

value.name: Rosa hides the croissants
value.description: Rosa puts the croissants in the kitchen and pretends they are not there.
evidence: "Rosa put them in the kitchen and is pretending they are not there."

value.name: Lucia reports Rosa's sleepless night
value.description: Lucia explains that Rosa did not sleep and was heard polishing silver at four in the morning.
evidence: "I heard her in the kitchen at four. She was — I think she was polishing the silver."

value.name: Lucia comforts Rosa in Spanish
value.description: Lucia sits with Rosa, says nothing at first, and they agree in Spanish to figure out living in the house slowly.
evidence: "I went down. I sat with her. I didn't say anything. After a while she said in Spanish that she did not know how to be in this house and not work in it. I said in Spanish that I did not know either. We agreed to figure it out slowly."

value.name: Lucia admits anger and relief
value.description: Lucia confesses that she is angry at him, relieved, and ashamed of how relieved she feels.
evidence: "I'm angry," Lucia said. "I'm angry at him in a way I didn't know I had room for. I'm also — I don't know. Relieved. A little ashamed of how relieved."

value.name: Lucia feels burden lifted
value.description: Lucia says she feels as if she has put down something she did not know she was carrying.
evidence: "Like I get to put down something I didn't know I'd been carrying."

value.name: Lucia wants to tell her mother
value.description: Lucia says she keeps wanting to call her mother and tell her Asha found it.
evidence: "I keep wanting to call my mother and tell her you found it."

value.name: Asha agrees with Lucia
value.description: Asha unexpectedly agrees that Lucia's mother would say it took them long enough.

value.name: Asha and Lucia walk to dining room
value.description: Asha and Lucia go down the hall together toward the dining room.
evidence: They went down the hall together.

value.name: dining room is rearranged
value.description: Asha sees that the dining room has been deliberately rearranged, with the boxes removed and legal pads set out.
evidence: The dining room had been rearranged in a small but deliberate way.
